name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: Actions at the pointer, with touch long press and keyboard access. Shared menus support submenus, shortcuts, independent selections and animated density.
example:
<ContextMenu density="compact">
  <ContextMenuTrigger aria-label="Actions for release notes">Release notes.md</ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ActionMenuPopover>
    <ActionMenu aria-label="File actions">
      <ActionMenuItem id="open" onAction={openFile}>Open</ActionMenuItem>
      <ActionMenuItem id="duplicate" onAction={duplicateFile}>Duplicate</ActionMenuItem>
      <ActionMenuSeparator />
      <ActionMenuItem id="delete" variant="destructive" onAction={deleteFile}>Delete</ActionMenuItem>
    </ActionMenu>
  </ActionMenuPopover>
</ContextMenu>
